verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own docs say any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail) can connect to an AgentMail inbox, so mail is reachable over open protocols and no single client locks the user in. That rests on a single doc mention, and nothing covers JMAP or a standards-based bulk export. Missing for 10: JMAP access, documented standards-based export (e.g. mbox/EML), depth of IMAP/SMTP documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
